This is the ANSWER KEY: do not edit it to tune the matcher. `kind`: constructive = text built from the issue's own keywords (assert recall 1.0); decoy = text with no issue keyword (assert it matches nothing); real = a redacted snippet sampled from opencode.db (report precision/recall/FPR; labels are the human ground truth by the rule below).
method: Sample query: DISTINCT substr(json_extract(data,'$.text'),1,200) FROM part WHERE type IN ('text','reasoning') AND data LIKE '%blank%'|'%black screen%'|'%plugin%'|'%image%'|'%stall%'|'%freeze%'|'%not render%'. Text redacted with scripts/redact.mjs before committing. Label rule: a row is positive for issue X iff it names the same failure mode as X, else null. Labels are blind to matchIssues output (authored before scoring).
